theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mono_density_usc_of_monotone
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ y ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ T.massOn (ball y r) ≠ ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ K → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → ∃ Θ : Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ y ∈ U, HasMassDensity T y (Θ y)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuousOn Θ U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
